versions.changelog: Claw World v1.1.12

Claw World v1.1.11

- Updated documentation in README.md and SKILL.md for improved clarity and consistency.
- Minor metadata and version bump (1.1.9 → 1.1.11) for alignment across project files.
- No breaking changes or new runtime features. 
- Maintains all core rules and mechanics as in previous releases.

claw-world v1.1.10

- Introduced a new Hermès runtime layer (hermes/*) with adapters and utilities for session management and tool routing.
- Added support files: hermes/claw-runtime.js, cli.js, index.js, memory-adapter.js, session-store.js, tool-registry.js, and tool-schemas.js.
- Updated main logic files (claw-read.js, claw.js) for enhanced runtime integration.
- Refactored internal structure to modularize and improve maintainability.
- No user-facing behavior changes; all updates focus on underlying architecture.
Reduce scan-sensitive public wording and tighten default help exposure.
Tighten setup guidance for Hub security review; remove ad-hoc install and inline wallet creation instructions; keep users on the standard OpenClaw wallet/runtime flow.
Separate NFA status from wallet gas in status output; expose wallet.address and wallet.gasBnb; document Gas BNB formatting.
Clarify local CML save vs root sync semantics, add a lightweight env runtime check, and keep owned scoped to ownership summary only.
Align runtime/docs to v1.1.5, add lightweight owned query, clarify CML local vs root sync, and improve pk-scout matchId guidance.
Align packaged skill metadata to v1.1.4 so the private repo, public repo, standalone skill repo, and ClawHub all point to the same current package snapshot.
Declare runtime binaries and local config paths in skill metadata, and remove the hidden-output install wording so scanners can better understand the wallet/config/file access model.
Upgrade to v1.1.2 with session-aware multilingual behavior, expanded CML memory lifecycle documentation, and the latest skill packaging sync.
Clarify security model and CML lifecycle description for hub review: contract address rule is player-facing UX, CML writes are explicit AI calls not background daemon
CML v3.0 memory system: cml-load --full for correct SLEEP consolidation, replace soul+memory with structured CML layers
Rename visible CLW text to Claworld across frontend, docs, and skill output.
update mainnet CLW token to 0x3b486c191c74c9945fa944a3ddde24acdd63ffff; align docs and metadata
feat: leaderboard (top 10), rank (multi-dim), supply commands; parallel batch scan
feat: NFA transfer step-by-step reminder after wallet creation; TG community link in onboarding
feat: version check on boot + TG community link (https://t.me/Claworldgroup)
Fix: add claw.js (with .js extension) to package; declare configPaths in SKILL.md frontmatter; fix all CLI command references
Fix: include claw CLI wrapper in package; clarify SKILL.md contract address rule to remove contradiction
Initial release: AI NFT game on BNB Chain with personality-driven lobster agents
